title: “Di Ting” Customer Service Agent
summary: Hubei Telecom reports that Di Ting shortened new-agent training from three months to one week and reduced average handling time by 10%.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Di Ting assists agents with intent recognition, information retrieval, and service actions in Hubei Telecom’s customer-service center. The source reports shorter training and handling time, faster workflow changes, and favorable user surveys. The account provides no independent validation of these operational and cohort-level claims.
purpose: Help customer-service personnel learn and complete telecom service tasks.
deployer: Hubei Customer Service Center, China Telecom

ratings.reason: Hubei Telecom reports that training shortened from three months to one week and handling time fell by 10%.
New-agent cohorts reportedly complete training in one week rather than three months. Learning quality has not been separately compared.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: “Di Ting” Customer Service Agent

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Di Ting shortens customer-service training and handling time
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
